// Package towerdefense 是四人合作塔防教学业务，地图、数值与战斗规则不属于 core。
package towerdefense

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/configdata"
	"io"
)

var ErrRule = errors.New("tower defense: invalid identity, phase, operation or limit")

const Seats = 4
const LedgerLimit = 128
const MaxTime int64 = 4000000000000

type Rules struct {
	Version                           string
	PrepMillis, TickMillis            int64
	Waves, EnemyHP, BaseHP, BuildCost int
}

func DemoRules() Rules { return Rules{"tower-v1", 10000, 500, 3, 6, 12, 3} }
func (r Rules) Validate() error {
	if r.Version == "" || len(r.Version) > 64 || r.PrepMillis < 100 || r.PrepMillis > 60000 || r.TickMillis < 100 || r.TickMillis > 5000 || r.Waves < 1 || r.Waves > 8 || r.EnemyHP < 1 || r.EnemyHP > 100 || r.BaseHP < 1 || r.BaseHP > 100 || r.BuildCost < 1 || r.BuildCost > 10 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return nil
}
func encode(v any) string {
	b, e := json.Marshal(v)
	if e != nil {
		panic(e)
	}
	return string(b)
}
func strictJSON(s string, v any) error {
	if len(s) == 0 || len(s) > 256*1024 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewBufferString(s))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if e := d.Decode(v); e != nil {
		return e
	}
	if d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return nil
}
func (r Rules) Hash() string { b := sha256.Sum256([]byte(encode(r))); return hex.EncodeToString(b[:]) }
func OpenCatalog(dir string) (*configdata.Store, error) {
	r := configdata.NewRegistry()
	configdata.MustRegisterObject(r, configdata.ObjectDef[Rules]{Name: "tower_rules", File: "tower.json", Validate: func(_ *configdata.BuildContext, r Rules) error { return r.Validate() }})
	s := configdata.NewStore(r, dir)
	_, e := s.Load(context.Background())
	return s, e
}
func CaptureRules(s *configdata.Snapshot) (Rules, error) {
	r, ok := configdata.ObjectFrom[Rules](s, "tower_rules")
	if !ok {
		return r, ErrRule
	}
	return r, r.Validate()
}
